accent-hot.displayName: Hot Red (focus, live, a filter that is on, a text action on hover)

rule.displayName: Rule (13% white): a data table, a progress spine

paper.displayName: Paper (white 94%): prints, slips, cards on the black table

tape.displayName: Tape (white 82%): a typed label over a print, never a group label

paper-ink-dim.displayName: Dim Paper Ink (black 66%, 5.3:1 on paper; edges, roles, states)

ink-strong.displayName: Strong Ink (white 85%): the hero facts line

ink.displayName: Ink (white 78%): the footer, the newsletter lede

ink-soft.displayName: Soft Ink (white 70%): the head-rule note, subpage ledes, the EndLine line, an unpressed filter, the desktop bar's second group

ink-meta.displayName: Meta Ink (white 62%): group labels (partner tiers, the hosts), the footer column titles, the ticket footnote

ink-dim.displayName: Dim Ink (white 60%): the invoice step numbers, the FAQ "+" marker

ink-monogram.displayName: Monogram Ink (white 46%, 4.21:1): initials in the large empty photo well

ink-monogram-sm.displayName: Monogram Ink, small (white 66%, 7.71:1): initials at label scale

panel-lit.displayName: Lit Panel (4% white): the agenda lanes and room heads

rule-strong.displayName: Strong Rule (22% white): the short mark between the desktop bar's two link groups

display.purpose: Bebas --fs-display clamp(3rem, 9.5vw, 9rem): the speaker sheet's name, the menu panel's primary links under 901px, the invite title, the live ticket slip's name and price on a phone.

headline.purpose: Bebas --fs-h2 clamp(2.25rem, min(6vw, 9svh), 5.5rem): the FAQ categories, the session sheet's title, the /thank-you date, the /invoice steps head, the live ticket slip's name and price, the menu panel's primary links >=901px.

head.purpose: A compact head on paper (--fs-head clamp(2.1rem, 3.4vw, 3rem)): the NextStep titles, the /contact index-card titles, the /venue card titles and numbers, a clipping's headline, the partnerships contact's name, the legal h2, the workshop slip title.

lede.purpose: Section ledes and status prose; the home facts note and newsletter lede.

label.purpose: JetBrains Mono records figures only: the ticket slip's date stamp and company figure, the FAQ index numbers, agenda break times. Never a word-label.

label-lg.purpose: The larger mono figure: the agenda time gutter and the lounge hours, the session sheet's time, the invite meta line.

label-xs.purpose: Micro mono figure at 0.6875rem = 11px, the mono floor: every .paper-edge, agenda and session slip edges, FAQ question numbers, avatar counts, kit file sizes, the footer folio.

note-sm.purpose: Special Elite tells: roles, captions, tape labels, row metadata (the ticket alt price, the speaker role, agenda room notes), form labels and errors on paper. Sentence case, tracking 0, line-height 1.45; 0.85rem is the floor.

note.purpose: Special Elite tells: .eyebrow, a speaker print's talk, the hosts label, a partner tier label, a press-kit variant label, the agenda lounge line, nav meta, the FAQ index label. A label made of words is this voice, never mono; a group label is this, never tape.

action.purpose: Bebas speaks: the text action (.action / .btn-ghost), the nav toggle, desktop bar and footer links, Sheet close, speaker social links, the session filters, Clear. Caps, line-height 1, no glyph.

cta.purpose: The label on a red button (cta-label = action(--fs-cta)): white Bebas at 1.5rem = 24px, the regular-weight large-text line where white on #F11000 (4.36:1) clears AA; the header Tickets, every .btn-primary, the newsletter submit and cookie Accept (black fills). Never shrink it. Also the size of the agenda room filter, the FAQ index, the EndLine action and the NextStep card action.

title-sm.purpose: Bebas 1.45rem: speaker print names <=720px, a talk slip's title on the speaker sheet, a clipping's headline <=720px.

subpage.purpose: The subpage <h1> in SubpageHero: Bebas --fs-subpage clamp(5rem, 13vw, 12.5rem), one per page, type-first, beside a factual lede; SubpageHero takes no photograph.

section.purpose: The poster section head (.head-rule-title): Bebas --fs-section clamp(4rem, 9vw, 8rem), on space, never on a rule; on / only the lead sections (the event, Tickets, Speakers, Past editions), the utility heads (Partners, Get the app, Newsletter) take --fs-h2. Also every secondary poster title (the /venue address and "The entrance", "Become a partner", "Press kit") and every Closer title.

card-title.purpose: Bebas 1.95rem: the speaker name on a print (line-height 0.92; every print the same size, --fs-title-sm <=720px), the live slip's Buy label.

body-lg.purpose: Special Elite 1.15rem / 1.6: the .head-rule note in soft ink (max 34ch), subpage ledes, footnotes, a session slip's title.

hero.purpose: Bebas --fs-hero clamp(4.25rem, 10.5vw, 9.25rem), line-height 0.86: the home statement, the one display element on /, above every section head at every width.

h3.purpose: Bebas --fs-h3 clamp(1.8rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem): a ticket slip's price, /team names, the menu's secondary links.

label-sm.purpose: JetBrains Mono 0.74rem: the agenda time gutter <=1100px, counts.

ui.purpose: Special Elite 0.95rem: small UI prose and help text; a form's status line.

monogram.purpose: Bebas 3.4rem: initials in an empty photo well, in --ink-monogram.

shadows.name: paper-shadow
shadows.purpose: Flat paper set down on the flat black table: a tight drop pulled in by its negative spread so it stays under its own print and never falls across a neighbour, plus one contact shadow. A property of the paper at rest, never a hover state. Every paper takes this one shadow: a card or clipping set a gap apart takes it as is; close-set slips (agenda, sessions, workshops) draw the same token on a ::before under an isolated grid.

shadows.name: statement-lift
shadows.purpose: The home statement's legibility lift on the hero photograph (the topics under it and the event print's subtitle carry two more); type on a photograph only, never on the black ground. Recorded as an open point, not a style.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: The standard control transition: buttons, inputs, links; a text action's colour turning accent-hot on hover and focus.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: The house arrive curve: sheet entry and the menu panel's slide in and out.

motion.name: develop
motion.purpose: The signature motion: the speaker print (on the grid and in the session sheet) develops from B&W to colour while its link or button is hovered or focused; on /team the colour bleeds from the cursor (0.7s); the invite portrait develops once on arrival. Every other print stays B&W. With the portrait view transition into the speaker sheet, the only decorative motion. A print's tilt is set, never animated.

motion.name: bar-link
motion.purpose: The desktop bar links' and the menu panel links' colour.

motion.name: menu-panel
motion.value: open 0.24s ease / 0.36s; close 0.28s ease / 0.32s; slide on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: The full-screen menu panel: opacity and a short slide on the arrive curve.

motion.name: step-figure
motion.purpose: The card builder's step figures and spine, the footer social marks, the FAQ marker turning to a cross.

motion.name: header-slide
motion.purpose: The header sliding away and back (auto-hide under 760px) and its scrim fading; the cookie slip's fade and 1.5rem drop.

motion.name: crew-swap
motion.purpose: The /team role cross-fading into the member's codename.

motion.name: portrait-morph
motion.purpose: The speaker portrait view transition into the sheet, and the root cross-fade behind it.

motion.name: team-bleed
motion.purpose: The /team colour bleeding from the cursor through a radial mask and a tiled feTurbulence noise mask.

motion.name: tv-progress
motion.purpose: The venue screens' live progress spine.

motion.name: invite-develop
motion.purpose: The /invite/<member> portrait developing to colour once on arrival.

motion.name: loops
motion.purpose: The loading pulse, the ticket skeleton shimmer and the workshop busy spinner; the pulse and the shimmer stop under reduced motion, the spinner slows to 2.4s.

motion.name: tv-drift
motion.purpose: The venue screens' 1px burn-in drift, one step every six minutes; off under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A red fill: the header Tickets on every page, then at most one per screen (the hero's "Get tickets" or, with the sale off, "Stay in the loop", the live slip's "Buy", a closer's primary, a sheet's "Get tickets", the brand-manual download, the partnership deck, the invoice and workshop submits, "Download .ics"). On paper where the screen's red is spent elsewhere the same control is a black fill (the newsletter submit, the cookie Accept, a workshop slip's Register). White Bebas at --fs-cta 24px (brand manual p. 11; AA as large text only, never shrink), tracking 0, no glyph. Hover inverts the fill; no lift, no glow.

components.name: Text Action
components.description: The second control, and the last (.action; .btn-ghost draws the same thing for its older callers). Bebas --fs-action caps, tracking 0, no box, no fill, no underline, no glyph; vertical padding only, min-height 2.75rem. Hover and focus turn the label red (--color-accent-hot); nothing moves. On paper it takes paper-action(): --paper-ink, no line at rest, a 2px ink underline on hover and focus (the slip's "Company pays", "Email Filip", the /venue route action, a NextStep card's action, the /thank-you calendar link, the workshop and card-builder actions). Every "see all", way-across, EndLine link and the ticket head's "Request a company invoice" are this.

components.name: Section Head
components.description: The section head (.head-rule, the class keeps its old name): SubpageHero's grid, minmax(0, 1fr) beside minmax(0, var(--side-col)) with --side-gap between, aligned to the foot: a poster-scale Bebas --fs-section title left and, in the right column, at most one note (Special Elite --fs-body-lg, line-height 1.6, soft ink, max 34ch) or the section's text actions, so every head's note starts at the hero note's x. A head with no note spans both columns; one column <=720px. No rule: space closes it (margin-bottom clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem)). The note carries a fact ("24 on stage. Times in CET.", "Eleven editions since 2012.", the invoice route on Tickets) or is left off. The eleventh DevFest.cz, Tickets, Speakers, Past editions, Partners on /; "Every talk", "The route", "In the news" on subpages.

components.name: Paper Print
components.description: The darkroom primitive (.paper, .paper-photo, .paper-edge, .tape, .grease in BaseLayout.scss). A photograph is a print: a white-at-94% border (0.65rem on three sides, open at the foot), flat, the tight paper shadow, a tilt from --tilt-1 0.8deg to --tilt-3 2.2deg and never more (clamped to --tilt-1 <=720px); inside it the black well with the image in grayscale(1) contrast(1.1); under it the mono edge (a frame or sheet number, a date or time; a word on it is a note). One tape per print, at its top-left, one line, never cut with an ellipsis. Only prints tilt: the same paper carries straight slips, cards and forms with no photograph (agenda and session slips, the speaker sheet's talk slips, the invite quote, the share page's no-script slip, the open FAQ question, index cards, clippings, NextStep cards, the newsletter and invoice forms, the cookie slip), all on the one --paper-shadow; the home ticket slips are the one paper without a photograph that tilts. A page spends one decorative red grease-pencil mark.

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: A plain typewriter note where a list has no poster head: the NextStepList head, a Closer eyebrow. Special Elite --fs-note, sentence case, no tracking, no decoration, no trailing hairline; never uppercased, never mono.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-special-elite, 'Special Elite', cursive); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.45; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); margin: 0; }

components.name: Ticket Slip
components.description: One paper ticket slip per wave under the "Tickets" head (whose note is the invoice route), the one paper without a photograph that tilts. The wave on sale leads: the big slip first on the left (a 35rem / 28rem grid spread to the head's edges), the other waves small in the right column stacked from the top. The big slip, tilted --tilt-1: the wave name Bebas --fs-h2, the price JetBrains Mono at --fs-h2, the other variant's price as a note line ("Company funded 1 452 Kc"), the state as a note in dim paper ink ("On sale.", the deadline), a perforation of punched holes through to the table, then the VAT line and the mono event date left and the red Buy (--fs-card-title) and the paper-ink "Company pays" right. A spent wave is a small slip tilted -tilt-3, its paper a shade darker, crossed out by the grease pencil (a state, not the page's decorative mark); a wave still to come is a small plain slip. Phones stack the slips full width, the live one first.

components.name: Typed Field
components.description: Every form sits on paper, so a field is a typed line, no box: Special Elite --fs-lede in paper ink on a 2px paper-ink underline that turns red on focus and on aria-invalid, with the keyboard ring at --focus-gap; the label a note in dim paper ink, going to full ink while its field has focus; an error in paper ink behind a 4px red margin mark. On the black ground (the "Every talk" search) a control keeps the --field-border boundary and types its query as a note.

components.name: Speaker Print
components.description: Every speaker as a paper print on the black table, in running order (start time, then room; then untimed; then hosts), the same print on / (links; eight, TEASER_SIZE, then "All N speakers" as a text action under the grid) and on /speakers (buttons opening the sheet; the print's photo morphs into the sheet's; the hosts in the same grid under a plain "Hosts" label; the page ends on an EndLine "Full agenda" / "Get tickets"). A print: one tape at its top-left naming the room (none on a host), the 4:5 B&W portrait cropped from the top, the Bebas name at --fs-card-title in paper ink, the role as a note, wrapping, the talk as a note, "With ..." for co-speakers, and the mono edge "NN / NN" and the CET start pinned to the foot; a row's prints are one height. Tilts cycle so neighbours never match. Reached, the name turns red and the portrait develops to colour. Every print is the same size, 4:5, the opening keynote included: only its tape says "Opening keynote, <room>". Four columns (three on /speakers <=1100px), two <=720px.

components.name: Agenda Slip
components.description: /agenda as slips on the table. Over it a bar: the room filter (Bebas words, red when on) and "All times Prague (CET)". Desktop: every room is a column, a faint lane under its Bebas name (no tape) pinned below the bar while the day scrolls; the lounge (open all day) is a lane with one block from open to close (mono hours, Bebas title, "Drop in any time" note). A mono gutter names each start; the grid is not to scale (one row per moment something starts or ends). Each talk is a straight, flat paper slip from its start line to its end line (a workshop one sheet over its span), the shadow under the isolated grid: a mono edge (time range) with the track and length as a note, the title in Special Elite --fs-body, the speakers in Bebas, and a "Live now" flag behind a red dot. A break is a quiet typewriter line across the rooms; a "Slot open" is a dashed outline. A break one narrow room wide drops its title under the time, never splitting a word. Phones (<=720px): the room filter is one line scrolling sideways inside the viewport; one compact list grouped by start time, the room named on each slip's edge, the lounge one line above it (the room in Bebas, the rest a note, the hours mono).

narrative.northStar: Noir, but loud — the darkroom: prints on a black table in three voices
narrative.overview: A film-noir darkroom: a single flat black table, white ink, greys only as white at an opacity, and the photographs and the facts that travel with them laid on it as flat paper (white at 94%, black ink, a tight shadow): photographs as prints with a white border, one tape and a mono edge, set down by hand at a small tilt; ticket slips, agenda and session slips, index cards and forms as straight paper (the home ticket slips the one paper without a photograph that tilts). A page spends one red grease-pencil mark. Section heads are poster-scale Bebas on space, never on a rule, one gap between sections; subpages open on type. Red is a fill (the header Tickets and at most one per screen), a grease stroke or a state, never running text and never a ground. Two controls and no third: the red fill and the Bebas text action, neither carrying a glyph. Three voices: Bebas speaks (headlines and actions), Special Elite tells (prose and every label made of words), JetBrains Mono records (figures only). Nothing glows, nothing moves on its own; the speaker prints develop to colour under the pointer.
keyCharacteristics: One theme, and it is dark: a flat black table, no spotlight
Photographs are paper prints; facts that travel with them are straight paper slips and cards in the same paper and ink
Paper and tape are white at an opacity, ink on paper is black at an opacity; no cream; paper is flat with a tight shadow
Only photographs tilt (the home ticket slips the one exception), alternating, never past --tilt-3; on a phone every print is equal and barely tilted
One tape per print, top-left, never cut; group labels are plain type; one decorative red grease mark per page
Poster-scale section heads on space, one gap between sections; subpages open on type
Two controls site-wide: the red fill (the header Tickets plus at most one per screen) and the Bebas text action; no arrow glyphs, a hover is red
Three voices: Bebas speaks, Special Elite tells, JetBrains Mono records figures only
Three faces: Bebas Neue, Special Elite, JetBrains Mono (brand manual v1.0)
No glow: hover and live states are flat colour changes; the paper shadow is the paper's, not a hover
No icon library; the few inline marks are drawn and aria-hidden

rules.name: The Darkroom Rule
rules.body: Photographs are paper prints on the flat black table (.paper, .paper-photo, .paper-edge): a white-at-94% border, flat, the tight paper shadow, a mono edge. A fact that travels with them (a ticket, a talk, an inbox, an open question, a form) is a straight slip or card in the same paper and ink (--paper-ink black, --paper-ink-dim black 66%). One tape (white 82%, a typed note) per print, at its top-left, never cut with an ellipsis; a group (a partner tier, the hosts, an agenda room) is labelled in plain type, never tape. A page spends one decorative red grease-pencil mark (frame 12A on /, the /venue door, the /contact inbox); the cross over a sold-out wave is a state and allowed beside it. Only prints tilt, by a fraction or a step of --tilt-1 0.8deg / --tilt-2 1.4deg / --tilt-3 2.2deg, alternating so neighbours never match, never past --tilt-3, and at most --tilt-1 under 720px; the home ticket slips are the one paper without a photograph that tilts.

rules.name: The Red Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Brand manual v1.0 (p. 08-09): three colours, #000000, #FFFFFF, #F11000; greys only as white or black at an opacity (panels, ink, paper and tape are rgba()). Red marks details (a dot, 1-2 headline words, the year, CTA words, a grease-pencil stroke, a text action under the pointer) and, as a large area, only red buttons. No red ground: every closer, the /partners CTA and the newsletter sit on black. Never running text (in-prose links are white on a red underline), never a wash, never another accent hue. On paper, red is a stroke, a dot or a button: #F11000 on --paper is about 3.8:1, so small text on paper stays in paper ink. One red mark per list (manual p. 11). Errors stay red: a state.

rules.name: The Size Not Dimming Rule
rules.body: On red, hierarchy comes from size. On flat #F11000 ink is #000000 at full opacity (4.8:1); 85% black is for control boundaries only; white only for large type (4.36:1). A red button's label is white Bebas at --fs-cta 1.5rem = 24px (cta-label = action(--fs-cta)), the regular-weight large-text line; Bebas has no bold, so the size carries it, never smaller. Red type on black (the ticket state word) is 4.82:1.

rules.name: The Two Controls Rule
rules.body: Every action is a red fill (.btn-primary: white Bebas caps at --fs-cta on #F11000, inverted on hover) or the Bebas text action (.action / .btn-ghost: --fs-action caps, tracking 0, no box, no fill, no underline, vertical padding only, min-height 2.75rem, the label turning --color-accent-hot on hover and focus). No arrow glyph anywhere. A boxed secondary, an underlined standalone link or a second filled colour is a third control and does not ship. Red fills: the header's Tickets on every page plus at most one per screen; where a screen's red is spent elsewhere a fill on paper is black (the newsletter submit, the cookie Accept). A filter is a Bebas word, red when on.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Bebas speaks: headlines and actions (display(), row-title(), action(), cta-label). Special Elite tells: prose and every label made of words (prose(), note()): eyebrows, roles, captions, tape labels, group labels, form labels, errors, status words, the ticket state, nav meta, the footer. JetBrains Mono records figures only (mono()): prices, times, frame and sheet numbers on a print's edge, counts, codes, the footer folio; a word on an edge is a note. Two recorded exceptions: a press clipping's excerpt sets in mono for its Czech glyphs (its outlet is a note on the edge), and speaker names on prints and slips set in Bebas. note() is sentence case, tracking 0, line-height 1.45, floored at --fs-note-sm; action() is Bebas caps at --fs-action, tracking 0, line-height 1.

rules.name: The Poster Head Rule
rules.body: A section opens on .head-rule (the class keeps its old name): the section's plain name in Bebas --fs-section (clamp(4rem, 9vw, 8rem)) left and, on its baseline, at most one note (Special Elite --fs-body-lg, soft ink, max 34ch) or the section's text actions in the right column, the column SubpageHero's note takes (--side-col, --side-gap), so every note on a page starts at one x. No rule under it. Space closes it, and one gap parts two sections: a band hands its bottom air to the closer after it, the last band closes on --section-y-tight and the footer adds none. A subpage title sets at --fs-subpage in SubpageHero, which carries no photograph. Headings are literal: no puns.

rules.name: The Head Note Is A Fact Rule
rules.body: A head note carries a fact the visitor needs, never a label of the section's own contents: Speakers ("N on stage. Times in CET."), Past editions ("Eleven editions since 2012."), Tickets (the invoice route, a quiet side door beside the poster title), "Every talk" (how to search), "The route" (the train and the walk), "In the news" (where the press kit is). Partners takes its two text actions in the note's place. A note that only names what follows is filler and is left off.

rules.name: The Structural Rule Rule
rules.body: Space and paper part the page, not lines. A line is drawn only in data tables, as a control boundary (on paper a 2px ink underline), as an in-prose underline, as a progress spine, as the dashed outline of a place still empty (an open agenda slot), and as the short mark between the desktop bar's two link groups. Never a rule under a section head, a divider between sections, a line above the hero's facts line, a ruled readout, a rule down an agenda room column, or a box drawn round a partner mark. The footer opens on space.

rules.name: The Poster Scale Rule
rules.body: One --fs-subpage title per subpage; on / the statement at --fs-hero, above every section head at every width. Section heads, every secondary poster title and every Closer title at --fs-section; --fs-display for the speaker sheet's name and the menu panel; --fs-h2 for the FAQ categories and the session sheet's title; a compact head on paper at --fs-head.

rules.name: The One Red Word Rule
rules.body: The red accent word and the closing full stop belong to the home hero statement (and the invite title). Every subpage title carries neither; section heads and every Closer title are plain white.

rules.name: The No Fake Styles Rule
rules.body: font-synthesis: none. One weight per face (JetBrains Mono loads 400 and 500; 500 for the large figures on paper: the invoice estimate, the card builder's step numbers) and no italic, so prose emphasis is ink (strong steps up to --color-text). Czech letters Special Elite lacks fall to JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Motion Answers A Change Rule
rules.body: No scroll reveal, no per-section entrance, no page-entry animation: the hero lands still. Only the hero countdown moves on its own (by the second, no seconds under reduced motion); no ticker, no rotor, no marquee; the contact sheet is still; the agenda's live dot is static. One signature motion: the speaker print develops from high-contrast B&W (manual p. 13) to colour while reached; on /team the colour bleeds from the cursor. A print's tilt is set, never animated. Nothing lifts under the pointer; a text action's hover is a colour change. Hover painting only under (hover: hover).

rules.name: The Bebas Setting Rule
rules.body: Bebas sets uppercase at line-height 0.9-1.0 and tracking 0 (manual p. 10): --lh-display 0.9, --track-display 0, row-title() and action() line-height 1. No Bebas rule carries its own letter-spacing; no text-shadow on the black ground (the home statement and the event print's subtitle, both on a photograph, are an open point).

rules.name: The Mono Grid Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono tracks at 0.1-0.2em (manual p. 10); mono() floors effective tracking at 0.1em under --track-scale. A figure has no case to force (the paper edges and the folio keep uppercase, which only reaches a code). Notes and actions carry no tracking and do not move on a phone.

rules.name: The Logo Never Shrinks Rule
rules.body: Official files only (manual p. 03-07). The header logo is a fixed 190px box (180px digital minimum) and the brand never shrinks; the bar tightens on phones and drops its red Tickets under 380px instead. No opacity change on logo hover; nothing darkens the logo. No logo on the home hero: the bar carries the mark. The footer signs off with the official logo file at min(40rem, 80vw), pulled left by the file's own margin so the mark starts on the text column.

rules.name: The Recipe Rule
rules.body: Every font declaration goes through _type.scss (note, action, cta-label, mono, display, row-title, prose, hairline-link, paper-action); every font-size through the ramp.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No glow anywhere. Hover and live states are flat colour changes: an inverted fill for a button, a red label for the text action, an ink underline on paper. The paper shadow is the paper's, at rest; it never grows on hover.

rules.name: The Size By Tier Rule
rules.body: Partner logos sit on the black table with no tile, border or plate of the wall's own, each in its original colours (brand manual p. 15); dark-ink masters on a straight paper card. Each tier is labelled in plain type, never tape. The tier's reference box sets the size (CELLS: Platinum 600x300, Diamond 330x190, Gold 260x150, Silver 210x120, Community, Travel and Media 180x100 px); opticalBox() gives every mark in a tier the same ink area, handed to CSS as --logo-w. /partners scales each tier up through TIER_SCALE, one size per tier, and lines Diamond and Gold up in columns; narrower screens step whole tiers down; the home wall uses the boxes as they are with a --logo-scale per tier. Media stays on /partners.

rules.name: The End Line Rule
rules.body: Each page ends on its one next step. A Closer, on the black ground, ends a page that asks for a decision (agenda, workshops, venue, invite). A page that asks for none ends on an EndLine (one lede line and one or two text actions: /speakers "Full agenda" and "Get tickets", /contact, /team, FAQ, /app, the form and thank-you pages) or on its content (legal pages, the cards of /404 and /login, /partners' "Become a partner").

rules.name: The One Print Rule
rules.body: The detective key art is the home hero's alone: on the right of the hero, fading in from the left, with the statement, the facts and the red fill set over it. A subpage opens on type: SubpageHero takes no photograph. /venue's one print is the entrance, in a band; /contact's is the 2019 press print beside the clippings. Beyond the hero, / carries the event print, the speaker prints and the "Past editions" contact sheet with its enlargement; the menu panel carries one print of the venue.

rules.name: The Earned Noir Rule
rules.body: Noir wordplay is spent in a few earned places: the home hero statement, the 404 "Nothing filed under that", and at most one closer line per page. Every section and page title says plainly what it is ("Tickets", "Speakers", "Past editions", "Partners", "Newsletter", "Agenda", "Every talk", "The team", "FAQ", "Venue", "Contact", "Become a partner"); a head note is a fact or absent. The case dressing is the darkroom's: frame numbers and dates on a print's edge and the footer's folio. No triads, no em-dash chains, no hype words.

rules.name: The One Date Format Rule
rules.body: Event facts come from src/lib/event.ts: doors 08:00, keynote 09:00, close 19:00, afterparty to 23:00. "30 October 2026" in running copy, "30 Oct 2026" in mono facts, never "October 30"; 24-hour HH:MM; British spelling; the schedule is "the agenda", never "programme" or "program".

dos: Do use global primitives by class name (.band, .head-rule, .paper, .paper-photo, .paper-edge, .tape, .grease, .eyebrow, .display, .btn-primary, .action).
Do set a photograph as a .paper print with its edge, and a fact that travels with it as a paper slip or card in the same paper and ink.
Do tilt only photo prints (the home ticket slips the one exception), alternating so neighbours never match, under --tilt-3 (under --tilt-1 on a phone).
Do open a section on the poster .head-rule with the section's name, and a note only where it carries a fact.
Do spend one decorative grease mark per page, on the one thing that matters.
Do set every label made of words with note() and every action with action(); keep mono() for figures.
Do give every data-backed page a .fallback-note.
Do use --field-border (≥3:1) for a control boundary on black and --paper-ink on paper.
Do add a prefers-reduced-motion opt-out to every animation.
Do use .action for every "see all", way-across or secondary link, and the hairline-link mixin for a link inside running text.
Do render every partner mark through partnerLogo() and the partner-logo() recipe, so its tier's reference box sets its size.
Do give a print one tape, at its top-left, and label a group in plain type.
donts: Don't add a fourth font, an icon package, Tailwind or CSS-in-JS.
Don't set paragraphs in #F11000, or add a second red or any other accent hue.
Don't use a cream hex for paper; paper and tape are white at an opacity.
Don't set small red text on paper; a stroke, a dot or a button carries the red there.
Don't tilt a print past --tilt-3, or two neighbours the same way by the same step.
Don't add a third control: no boxed or outlined secondary, no underlined standalone link, no second filled colour.
Don't put an arrow or off-site glyph on a link or a button; the label names the destination.
Don't set a word-label in JetBrains Mono, uppercase a note, or track a note or an action.
Don't draw a rule under a section head or between sections; space parts the page.
Don't introduce a prefers-color-scheme block for a single component.
Don't give a head a note that only names what follows; a note is a fact or nothing.
Don't put a mood eyebrow ('Be there', 'Join us') on a closer; an eyebrow carries a fact or nothing.
Don't paint a red ground under a closer, a form or a section; the red on a screen is a button.
Don't spend a second decorative grease mark on a page or a second red mark in a list.
Don't add a glow to a hover or live state, or grow the paper shadow on hover.
Don't draw a tile, border or plate of the wall's own behind a partner logo; the tier's box carries the rank.
Don't set a mono figure under 11px (--fs-label-xs is the floor) or a note under --fs-note-sm.
Don't shrink, dim or overlay the logo; change the layout instead.
Don't set a label on red smaller than --fs-cta.
Don't put a photograph in a subpage hero; a subpage opens on type.
Don't add anything else that moves on its own: no rotor, ticker or marquee; the hero countdown is the one exception.
Don't spend noir wordplay on a plain title; name the page.
Don't tilt a slip, card, form or clipping; only photographs tilt.
Don't cut a tape with an ellipsis or put tape on a group label.
Don't put a gradient or spotlight under a band; the table is flat black.
